latestVersion.changelog:
- Added comprehensive coding guidelines for embedded C, focusing on production-quality code for platforms like STM32, PowerPC, RISC-V.
- Defined detailed naming, type, struct, and error-handling conventions for all generated, rewritten, or reviewed code.
- Specified mandatory use of separate reg.h files with structured register definitions and macros—no magic numbers, no scattered register addresses.
- Outlined modes for code generation, rewriting (with strict preservation of original logic), and review, each with explicit multi-step workflows.
- Included a PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) workflow and a detailed checklist to ensure all outputs meet the standard.
- Added common mistakes with clear before/after examples to guide correct implementation.
